title: Express selfgate / fallback (tmux, fake forge, level a): the default selfgate_engine is different and only an isolated --org-profile makes it same; an express item record needs Reason and is refused for crew:sensitive or crew:spec without an owner override, for crew:solo always and for unread labels; the selfgate record is checked for schema, head, key, signature, verdict, open findings, checks, mode and engine diversity; a resolved express change starts no reviewer, routes selfgate-passed and ci-passed to the synthesizer and red CI to the builder; the express gate replaces only the approval while CI, holds, rereview and merge permission still block; a cap with an open finding, a sensitive label or a tightening rename path at head returns the change to the crew lane with a fresh review at head; a green selfgate lands through a train

steps.run:
C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; O={state_dir}/../origin.git; R={state_dir}/../repo; F={source}/scripts/fixtures/campaign; V="python3 $F/a17/view.py"; PATH=$F/a14:$PATH; T="--grace 0 --interval 0 --timeout 10"
g() { git -C $R -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x "$@"; }; tip() { git -C $O rev-parse ${1:-main}; }; h() { tip refs/pull/$1/head; }
pr() { g checkout -q -B b$1 ${3:-main} && echo "$1 $2" >> $R/f$1.txt && g add -A . && g commit -qm "feat: $1" -m "Engine: ${4:-claude-code opus medium}" && g push -q -f origin HEAD:refs/pull/$1/head HEAD:refs/heads/builder/$1-x && g checkout -q --detach; }
n() { grep "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null | grep -c "\"#$2\""; }; pool() { CREW_POOL=reviewer $C reviewer-pool $P $X; }; kr() { CREW_POOL=reviewer $C kill reviewer-$1-r1-review $P >/dev/null && CREW_POOL=reviewer $C schedule release --pool reviewer "#$1" $P >/dev/null; }
tg() { mkdir -p $S/schedule && python3 -c "import json,sys,time; json.dump(dict(target=3,changed=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),starts=[]),open(sys.argv[1],'w'))" $S/schedule/target.json; }
rv() { python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(r['engine'], r['head'])" $S/runs/$1.json; }
sg() { w=$1; shift; $V 5 $H "$@" && out=$(python3 {source}/scripts/crew-precheck.py $P --pass selfgate --item 15 $X < $G/pr-view-5.json); rc=$?; echo "[$*] exit $rc: $out"; test "$out" = "selfgate: $w" && test $rc = $(test "$w" = pass && echo 0 || echo 1); }
H1=$(h 5); pr 5 two b5 || exit 1; H=$(h 5); echo "pr=5 head $H1 -> $H"
sg pass || exit 1
sg "missing marker" sg=none || exit 1
sg "stale marker" sg.sha=$H1 || exit 1
sg "malformed marker" sg.extra=1 || exit 1
sg "malformed marker" sg.reviews=4 || exit 1
sg "malformed marker" sg.round=1 || exit 1
sg "marker for 6, expected 5" sg.pr=6 || exit 1
sg "missing marker" "sgby=<reviewer-login>" || exit 1
sg "verdict changes" sg.verdict=changes sg.reviews=3 sg.findings=1 sg.open=1 || exit 1
sg "verdict pass with open findings" sg.findings=1 sg.open=1 || exit 1
sg "verdict pass with failed checks" sg.checks=fail || exit 1
sg "mode same, effective selfgate_engine different" sg.mode=same sg.reviewer-engine=claude-code/opus || exit 1
sg "engine clash: reviewer claude-code is a builder engine" sg.reviewer-engine=claude-code/sonnet || exit 1
sg "engine clash: reviewer codex is a builder engine" "engine=codex gpt-6.1-sol medium"

g() { git -C $R -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x "$@"; }; tip() { git -C $O rev-parse ${1:-main}; }; h() { tip refs/pull/$1/head; }
pr() { g checkout -q -B b$1 ${3:-main} && echo "$1 $2" >> $R/f$1.txt && g add -A . && g commit -qm "feat: $1" -m "Engine: ${4:-claude-code opus medium}" && g push -q -f origin HEAD:refs/pull/$1/head HEAD:refs/heads/builder/$1-x && g checkout -q --detach; }
n() { grep "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null | grep -c "\"#$2\""; }; pool() { CREW_POOL=reviewer $C reviewer-pool $P $X; }; kr() { CREW_POOL=reviewer $C kill reviewer-$1-r1-review $P >/dev/null && CREW_POOL=reviewer $C schedule release --pool reviewer "#$1" $P >/dev/null; }
tg() { mkdir -p $S/schedule && python3 -c "import json,sys,time; json.dump(dict(target=3,changed=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),starts=[]),open(sys.argv[1],'w'))" $S/schedule/target.json; }

H=$(h 5); H1=$(tip refs/pull/5/head~1)
ok() { out=$($C train check 5 $P); rc=$?; echo "$out" | grep "status=blocked"; test $rc = 0 && echo "$out" | grep -q 'name=verdict status=pass reason="express selfgate pass at '$H'"' && echo "$out" | grep -q 'name=express status=pass reason="resolved express"' && echo "pr=5 express gate passes ($(echo "$out" | grep -c status=manual) manual)"; }
miss() { w=$1; shift; $V 5 $H "$@" && out=$($C train check 5 $P $X); rc=$?; echo "miss [$*] exit $rc: $(echo "$out" | grep "status=blocked" | sed "s/^gate pr=[0-9]* sha=[0-9a-f]* //" | tr '\n' ' ')"; test $rc = 1 && echo "$out" | grep -q -- "$w"; }
$V 5 $H; ok || exit 1
miss 'express selfgate at head: missing marker' sg=none || exit 1
miss 'express selfgate at head: stale marker' sg.sha=$H1 || exit 1
miss 'express selfgate at head: verdict changes' sg.verdict=changes sg.reviews=3 sg.findings=1 sg.open=1 || exit 1
miss 'express selfgate at head: verdict pass with open findings' sg.findings=2 sg.open=1 || exit 1
miss 'express selfgate at head: malformed marker' sg.reviews=0 || exit 1
miss 'express selfgate at head: engine clash' sg.reviewer-engine=claude-code/sonnet || exit 1
miss 'name=ci status=blocked reason="checks failed"' ci=FAILURE || exit 1
miss 'name=ci status=blocked reason="checks pending"' ci=PENDING || exit 1
miss 'state tag crew:hold' label=crew:hold || exit 1
miss 'state tag crew:escalated' label=crew:escalated || exit 1
miss 'open rereview at head' "review=COMMENTED|<!-- crew:v1 role=coordinator pass=steer cmd=rereview pr=5 sha=$H -->" || exit 1
miss 'no merge permission: no merge-ok at head' ok=none || exit 1
miss 'name=express status=blocked reason="crew lane (item flavor standard (express-ineligible)): drop crew:express"' label=crew:sensitive || exit 1
miss 'name=express status=blocked reason="crew lane (item flavor standard (flavor-refused)): drop crew:express"' reason=none || exit 1
X="--org-profile {state_dir}/tight.toml"; miss 'name=express status=blocked reason="crew lane (tightening class rule): drop crew:express"' "files=src/auth/f5.py<lib/f5.py" || exit 1
$V 5 $H; ok
